paite: Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah nuam in la sa un; midik a ding in Pathian phat akilawm him ahi.
heading: Phatna La

paite: Kaihging in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen unla; pekging gui sawm nei in amah phat in la sa un.
Amah pahtawi in la thak sa unla; husa thupi toh siamtak in tum un.
TOUPA thu adik a; athilhih tengteng muanhuaitak a hih ahi ngal a.
Diktatna leh vaihawmna dik a-it nak a; leitung TOUPA zahngaihna in adim hi.
TOUPA thu in vante siam ahi a; huai a omte tengteng leng akam a hu a siam ahi uhi.
Ama'n tuipi tuite koihkhawm bang in abawl lemkhawm a; tui thukpite koihkhawmna innte ah akoih hoih zel hi.
Leitung luah tengteng in TOUPA laudan siam henla; khovel a om tengteng amah lau in om uhen.
Ama'n agen a, ahong omta a; thu apia a, ahong omkipta hi.
TOUPA'N namte lunggelna bangmah lou in a-omsak a; michih ngaihtuahnate bangmah phattuamna nei lou in asiam hi.
TOUPA lunggelna bel tangtawn in a-omkip ding a, alungtang a ngaihtuahte khang tengteng tan in a- omkip ding hi.
TOUPA Pathian anei nam ahampha uhi; amah gouluah ding a atel mite mah.
TOUPA'N van a kipan in a-en a; mihing tate tengteng amu nak hi.
Lei a om tengteng a-omna mun a kipan in ahon en zel hi.
Amaute tengteng lungtang sekpa'n athilhih tengteng uh a-enkhia hi.
Kumpipa himhim sepaih tam ziak lel a humbit ahi ngei kei, mihat thahat ziak lel a tatkhiak ahi sam kei.
Bitna ding in sakol bangmah ahi kei; ahat mahmah ziak lel in kuamah ahumbit tuan kei ding hi.
Ngai dih, TOUPA mit tuh amah laudan siamte tung ah atu gige a; azahngaihna lamente tung ah.
Ahinna uh sihna lak a humbit ding leh kial tun a amau tungding ding in.
I hinna in TOUPA angak nilouh a; amah hon panpihpa leh i phaw uh ahi.
Amah ah i lungtang anuam ding ahi; amin siangthou i muan ziak in.
TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna ka tung uah om hen, ka hon lamet bang zel un.
